primary.title: 8th Pay Commission: How could a 450-day leave encashment limit boost retirement payouts? Expert explains
primary.summary: The 8th Pay Commission may consider raising the leave encashment limit for central government employees from 300 to 450 days. Know how the proposal could boost retirement payouts, what unions are demanding and whether the change has been approved.
